WITH obs_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as obs_telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    obs_telescope_count,
    CAST(obs_telescope_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(SUM(obs_telescope_count) OVER () AS FLOAT) as share
  FROM obs_counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT 
  SUM(s.obs_telescope_count) as total_telescopes,
  AVG(s.share) as average_share,
  AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) as average_excess_share
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
